title: Truth
summary: Truth is not a weapon to win with — it is light from God. Jesus is the Truth; Scripture steadies the mind; honest living follows grace.
graceGuardrail: Knowing truth does not earn God's love. Jesus is the Truth who came for you first. Honesty is fruit of grace, not a ladder into belonging.
framing: Come here when you need clarity about who God is, what Scripture says, or how to live without hiding. Start with Jesus — then walk in the light.
why: Lies shrink the soul. Confusion multiplies fear. Scripture invites you to know the Truth who sets people free, and to speak and live honestly as a response to mercy.

sections.heading: Jesus is the Truth
paragraphs: Truth is personal before it is a list of facts. Jesus said, “I am the way, and the truth, and the life.” Knowing truth means knowing Him.
bullets: John 8:31–32 — abiding in His word; the truth sets free
John 1:14 — the Word became flesh, full of grace and truth

sections.heading: God's Word steadies the mind
paragraphs: Scripture is not a tool for winning arguments. It is light for the path — read in context, with Jesus at the centre.
bullets: John 17:17 — sanctify them in the truth; Your word is truth
Psalm 119:105 — Your word is a lamp to my feet
2 Timothy 3:16–17 — Scripture equips for every good work

sections.heading: Walk in the light
paragraphs: Living truthfully means dropping the mask — before God and, where wise, before people. Truth-telling is love; cruelty dressed as “honesty” is not.
bullets: Ephesians 4:15 — speak the truth in love
Ephesians 4:25 — put away falsehood; speak truth with your neighbour
1 John 1:5–7 — walk in the light; fellowship grows there
Proverbs 12:22 — lying lips are an abomination; those who act faithfully delight the Lord

sections.heading: When truth feels costly
paragraphs: Sometimes truth means confession. Sometimes it means a hard conversation. Sometimes it means refusing a convenient lie. Grace holds you while you take the next honest step.
bullets: Name what you have been hiding — before God first
Ask: “What would love and truth do next?”
Seek wise counsel when the truth involves safety, justice, or deep harm

sixtySecond: Say: “Jesus, You are the Truth. I need Your light today.”
Open one Gospel verse (start with John 14:6) and read it slowly.
Take one honest step — a confession, a clear word, or a refusal to pretend.
prayer: Jesus, You are the Truth. Free me from hiding and from using truth as a weapon. Teach me to love what is real, to trust Your Word, and to walk in the light with grace. Amen.

scripture.insight: Truth is found in a Person — Jesus — not only in ideas.
Truth sets free; it does not crush those who come to the light.
